9aa8876d-25c6-54d1-9b65-0816e604e7a5.definition: The area beside a railway track where people wait for and enter a train.
9aa8876d-25c6-54d1-9b65-0816e604e7a5.scene: Passengers stand safely behind the line on a railway platform beside the open doors of a train.
9aa8876d-25c6-54d1-9b65-0816e604e7a5.alt: Passengers wait on a railway platform beside a train.

faf13c57-a106-5406-a2bc-e743eb00ec4e.definition: A travel ticket for a journey in one direction only.
faf13c57-a106-5406-a2bc-e743eb00ec4e.scene: A traveller holds a ticket while a simple route shows one arrow from a home station to a destination station, with no return arrow.
faf13c57-a106-5406-a2bc-e743eb00ec4e.alt: A travel ticket shows a journey in one direction.

35b47079-26eb-5441-bf1d-05060d125a7e.definition: A travel ticket for a journey to a place and back again.
35b47079-26eb-5441-bf1d-05060d125a7e.scene: A traveller holds a ticket while a simple route shows an outward arrow and a separate arrow back between two stations.
35b47079-26eb-5441-bf1d-05060d125a7e.alt: A travel ticket shows an outward journey and a journey back.

91888c86-1fc6-5633-a6dd-a46017f8fdf7.definition: To leave one bus or train and continue your journey on another.
91888c86-1fc6-5633-a6dd-a46017f8fdf7.scene: A traveller leaves one bus and walks toward a second waiting bus at a transfer stop; a clear connecting arrow follows the person.
91888c86-1fc6-5633-a6dd-a46017f8fdf7.alt: A traveller gets off one bus and boards another.

0b593408-6679-5fb8-a21c-b73a525c76e5.definition: An object or group of objects wrapped for sending or delivery.
0b593408-6679-5fb8-a21c-b73a525c76e5.scene: A neatly wrapped cardboard package with a plain shipping label and twine sits ready to be sent.
0b593408-6679-5fb8-a21c-b73a525c76e5.alt: A wrapped parcel is ready to be sent.

3bb8e710-2cfb-5f6f-a281-c0a167d46fb2.definition: The details of where someone lives or where a building is.
3bb8e710-2cfb-5f6f-a281-c0a167d46fb2.scene: A delivery worker compares a location pin on a phone with the matching marked house doorway; a blank-lined envelope links the details to the location.
3bb8e710-2cfb-5f6f-a281-c0a167d46fb2.alt: A delivery worker matches a parcel's address to a house.

4609031d-af20-550a-906e-3fd3cde7588e.definition: The act of bringing goods or a parcel to a person or place.
4609031d-af20-550a-906e-3fd3cde7588e.scene: A courier hands a parcel directly to a person standing in their doorway, with a small delivery trolley nearby.
4609031d-af20-550a-906e-3fd3cde7588e.alt: A courier delivers a parcel to someone at home.

b20c1447-0e63-5712-9ae7-dd4aca9aeb85.definition: Money in the form of coins or notes.
b20c1447-0e63-5712-9ae7-dd4aca9aeb85.scene: A hand opens a purse containing paper money and coins beside a small shop counter; no bank cards.
b20c1447-0e63-5712-9ae7-dd4aca9aeb85.alt: An open purse holds notes and coins.

d78438f3-30bd-58bf-9b96-1489c4f57d3b.definition: A card linked to a bank account or credit account, used to pay or obtain money.
d78438f3-30bd-58bf-9b96-1489c4f57d3b.scene: A hand holds a plain bank card with a chip beside a payment terminal, clearly showing the card as the object.
d78438f3-30bd-58bf-9b96-1489c4f57d3b.alt: A hand holds a bank card beside a payment terminal.

c6a6c8f7-1ce0-59df-b963-e07066796992.definition: The act of paying money, or an amount of money paid.
c6a6c8f7-1ce0-59df-b963-e07066796992.scene: A customer taps a bank card on a shop terminal while the cashier hands over a purchase; a small check indicates completion.
c6a6c8f7-1ce0-59df-b963-e07066796992.alt: A customer pays for a purchase at a shop terminal.

b548ade3-8682-521e-bf26-848526519854.definition: A document with spaces for information that you need to provide.
b548ade3-8682-521e-bf26-848526519854.scene: A person fills in the empty boxes of a structured document on a clipboard, with name and date shown only as abstract lines.
b548ade3-8682-521e-bf26-848526519854.alt: A person fills in boxes on a form.

c7bbc8ae-3f64-58e9-acf0-3069e317c471.definition: Your name written in your usual way to sign a document.
c7bbc8ae-3f64-58e9-acf0-3069e317c471.scene: Close-up of a hand writing a flowing personal signature on the bottom line of a document with a pen.
c7bbc8ae-3f64-58e9-acf0-3069e317c471.alt: A hand signs the bottom of a document.

64360906-46e2-588e-96d7-c78213875c9b.definition: A line of people waiting for something.
64360906-46e2-588e-96d7-c78213875c9b.scene: A clear orderly line of people waits behind one person being served at a counter, with enough space to show the sequence.
64360906-46e2-588e-96d7-c78213875c9b.alt: People wait in a line at a service counter.

c76cb86d-be5a-5375-8d88-72bda7b98e7d.definition: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time, often for a service.
c76cb86d-be5a-5375-8d88-72bda7b98e7d.scene: A patient and clinic receptionist choose a time on a calendar, with a small doctor symbol and clock beside that slot.
c76cb86d-be5a-5375-8d88-72bda7b98e7d.alt: A patient arranges a time to see a clinician.

096a46ea-93b8-59c2-9423-bc07f3332297.definition: A physical or mental change that may be a sign of an illness or health problem.
096a46ea-93b8-59c2-9423-bc07f3332297.scene: A person sits holding their sore throat while describing it to a clinician, who listens and notes the concern.
096a46ea-93b8-59c2-9423-bc07f3332297.alt: A person tells a clinician about a sore throat.

c3a26504-d404-5151-bbac-5e22511aae5f.definition: A shop or service where people can get medicines.
c3a26504-d404-5151-bbac-5e22511aae5f.scene: A pharmacist behind a medicine counter helps a customer, with organized medicine boxes and a simple health cross in the background.
c3a26504-d404-5151-bbac-5e22511aae5f.alt: A pharmacist helps a customer at a medicine counter.

5966f508-b502-5669-a7d6-c619ce92639f.definition: The connection received by a mobile phone that allows it to communicate.
5966f508-b502-5669-a7d6-c619ce92639f.scene: A person outdoors raises a phone whose signal bars change from one faint bar to several strong bars as they move toward open space.
5966f508-b502-5669-a7d6-c619ce92639f.alt: A person checks the mobile signal on a phone outdoors.

2fd7a730-c9e9-5a7b-b094-dea868bc7cd3.definition: A system for recording spoken messages when a phone call is not answered, or a message on that system.
2fd7a730-c9e9-5a7b-b094-dea868bc7cd3.scene: An unanswered phone beside a person shows a recorded audio waveform and play button; another person's voice bubble is captured in the recording.
2fd7a730-c9e9-5a7b-b094-dea868bc7cd3.alt: A phone displays a recorded voice message and a play button.

e1b649b8-b6d8-5caf-8671-5b9e57ebd71c.definition: To phone someone after they have phoned you.
e1b649b8-b6d8-5caf-8671-5b9e57ebd71c.scene: A person notices a missed incoming call on a phone, then starts an outgoing call to the same small portrait; two sequential phone views.
e1b649b8-b6d8-5caf-8671-5b9e57ebd71c.alt: A person returns a missed phone call.

ee851d91-6476-5942-9454-8f1b2db92682.definition: A file sent with an email or other electronic message.
ee851d91-6476-5942-9454-8f1b2db92682.scene: A laptop email window shows a small photo document clipped inside a message area, with an arrow drawing the file into the message.
ee851d91-6476-5942-9454-8f1b2db92682.alt: A photo file is added to an email message.

ae343b98-d972-5565-8bac-87f04fe96d06.definition: A clickable address or item that opens an online page or resource.
ae343b98-d972-5565-8bac-87f04fe96d06.scene: A hand selects an underlined blue item on a tablet and a new webpage opens beside it; clear transition between two page views.
ae343b98-d972-5565-8bac-87f04fe96d06.alt: Selecting a blue link opens another webpage.

2d1adc4c-058b-5d12-ae17-86afc4195588.definition: To answer a message or question.
2d1adc4c-058b-5d12-ae17-86afc4195588.scene: Two phones show a received message bubble and a response bubble travelling back to the first sender.
2d1adc4c-058b-5d12-ae17-86afc4195588.alt: A person sends a response to a received message.

f97ad45b-01ee-51f9-b77a-ddab1881b374.definition: A scheduled period of time when someone works.
f97ad45b-01ee-51f9-b77a-ddab1881b374.scene: A cafe worker puts on an apron as another finishes and hands it over; a clock arc marks the incoming worker's scheduled work period.
f97ad45b-01ee-51f9-b77a-ddab1881b374.alt: One cafe worker leaves as another starts work.

ea64a58a-2521-50fa-8af9-a5cf9e013763.definition: A short time when you stop working to rest.
ea64a58a-2521-50fa-8af9-a5cf9e013763.scene: An office worker steps away from a desk to drink tea near a window, with the chair empty and work temporarily set aside.
ea64a58a-2521-50fa-8af9-a5cf9e013763.alt: A worker rests with a cup of tea away from their desk.

8ecac8d4-b7c0-51bb-95be-14a73d8637e3.scene: Two people wearing matching workplace badges work side by side on the same office task, helping one another.
8ecac8d4-b7c0-51bb-95be-14a73d8637e3.alt: Two coworkers work together at a shared desk.

e62a2ba4-c6b7-5186-98f6-20d69f4dc196.definition: New information about the current state or progress of something.
e62a2ba4-c6b7-5186-98f6-20d69f4dc196.scene: A teammate shows a project board changing from earlier incomplete stages to its current progress, pointing at newly completed items.
e62a2ba4-c6b7-5186-98f6-20d69f4dc196.alt: A teammate shares the latest progress on a project.

c1e69c4e-2915-5c99-96ab-d946e67653fd.definition: A talk that explains a topic to an audience, often using pictures or slides.
c1e69c4e-2915-5c99-96ab-d946e67653fd.scene: A speaker stands beside a screen of simple charts and pictures while a small seated audience watches.
c1e69c4e-2915-5c99-96ab-d946e67653fd.alt: A speaker presents charts and pictures to an audience.
